comment: kiln.npcspeech (dev.31, Marshall/Ryrin's request): the game's speech bubble over a friendly NPC, client build 26430625 / svn 1287369. Evidence: docs/re/npc-speech.md (static only: the bubble showing is for a real client to confirm). The HUD's NPC layer (doNpcUIWindow, '[GameUi] NPC Layer') calls NpcBubble(entry, layer, slots, pos) per nearby NPC: entry+0 is the NPC's entity id, entry+8 its dialogue record (ui_dialog's per-NPC record, 0x14b80 B, in G38UiPlayData+0x463de0). NpcBubble picks lines through PickLines(slot, record, storeGlobal) and draws the bubble with BubbleDraw(params): params+0 the line's loca tag, +4 show (fades), +5 hide at once; a tag of 0 keeps it hidden. PickLines is an anchor only (never hooked or called): the record's greeting lists are captured from its code. Lists: priority init lines (ptr, u64 count), plain greetings (ptr, u64 count); entries of rec.entry_size bytes with rec.vo_slots inline voice-over GUIDs at rec.entry_vo.

npcspeech/NpcBubble.comment: void(NpcLayerEntry*, void* layer, Slots*, const Pos*): one NPC's bubble state machine and draw. 2 callers, both in doNpcUIWindow

npcspeech/BubbleDraw.comment: void(BubbleParams*): the speech bubble widget. 2 callers: NpcBubble and one other HUD element (left alone: Kiln acts only inside NpcBubble)

npcspeech/PickLines.comment: void(BubbleSlot*, DialogueRecord*, bool): picks a random priority line, plain greeting and transition line into the slot. Anchor for the record captures only

find.pattern: 48 85 D2 74 70 FF CA 49 8B C9 E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 8B 9E {npcspeech/rec.prio_list:d32} 8B C0 48 69 C8 {npcspeech/rec.entry_size:d32} 48 03 D9

npcspeech/rec.prio_list.comment: record: the priority init lines' entries (pointer); 0x90 on 26430625

npcspeech/rec.entry_size.comment: one line entry: {u32 lineId; u32 bodyTexts[32] +8; u8 n +0x88; Guid vo[32] +0x8c; u8 nVo +0x28c}; 0x294

npcspeech/rec.vo_slots.comment: voice-over GUIDs per entry (the game stops at more than 32, creatures.md 7.8)

npcspeech/entry.record.comment: NpcBubble's entry: +0 entity id (u32), +8 the dialogue record (pointer)

npcspeech/bubble.show.comment: BubbleDraw's params: show (u8; fades in / out)

npcspeech.bubble.comment: Kiln's lines in the game's NPC speech bubble (Kiln.Npcs Say / Suppress / Replace) on a game client.

npcspeech.voice.comment: While Kiln speaks for an NPC, the greeting lines' voice-overs of its dialogue record are muted (put back after). Off: texts change, voices stay the game's.
